about: Voice identities and lines for GTA Melbourne. tools/voices/generate.py turns each line into an MP3 (Orpheus Australian-English TTS, offline) and writes its file, duration and check result back here; melbourne3d/js/voice-manager.js plays them. Paths are relative to /assets/audio/.

generator.model: ablmontazer/orpheus-australian-en-tts (Apache-2.0), run as mradermacher/orpheus-australian-en-tts-GGUF Q4_K_M with llama.cpp; SNAC 24 kHz decoder (hubertsiuzdak/snac_24khz, MIT)
generator.format: mp3, 24 kHz mono, 64 kb/s, loudness-normalised to -18 LUFS

lines.text: Heard you were back. I've got work, if you want it.

check.heard: Heard you were back. I've got work, if you want it."

lines.text: Flinders Lane, off Elizabeth Street. Don't keep me waiting.

check.heard: Finders Lane, off Elizabeth Street, don't keep me waiting.

lines.text: There you are. Six years this war's been going, and the Broadmeadows mob reckon they own the town now.

check.heard: There you are, six years this war has been going, and the Broadmeadows mob reckon they own the town now.

lines.text: Davo needs a lift. The trams won't cut it. Get your car and don't hang about.

check.heard: Daevo needs a lift. The trams won't cut it. Get your car and don't hang about.

lines.text: Every Sunday the Broady boys race their hotted-up cars round the Albert Park circuit.

check.heard: Every Sunday the Brody boys raced their hotted-up cars round the Albert Park circuit.

lines.text: One lap. Lakeside Drive, Aughtie Drive, back to the pits. Go.

check.heard: One lap, lakeside drive, otty drive, back to the pits. Go!

lines.text: So you're the one Vince keeps sending round. Forget the Lygon lot.

check.heard: So you're the one Vince keeps sending round, forget the Lygon lot.

lines.text: Good answer. The Westside Nomads have stashed their takings on a boat in Docklands. Get there before they move it.

check.heard: answer. The Westside nomads have stashed their takings on a boat in Docklands. Get there before they move it.

lines.text: Half the corner boys in the city owe us money and think we forgot.

check.heard: Half the corner boys in the city owe us money and think we forgot.

lines.text: Go to the Bourke Street Mall and remind three of them. Point the piece, ask for the wallet.

check.heard: Go to the Bork Street Mall and remind three of them Point the piece, ask for the wallet

lines.text: Three Nomads are dealing outside Southern Cross like they own the place.

check.heard: Three nomads are dueling outside Southern Cross like they own the place.

lines.text: They don't. Go and make that clear.

check.heard: They don't. Go and make that clear. Next.

lines.text: Victoria Police! Stop right there!
Drop the weapon! Get on the ground, now!

check.heard: Drop the weapon. Get on the ground. Now.

lines.text: Keep moving, folks. Nothing to see here.

check.heard: Keep moving, folks. Nothing to see here.

lines.text: All units, shots fired in the CBD. Respond code one.

check.heard: All units, shots fired in the CBD. Respond, code 1.

lines.text: Dispatch, we have a reported carjacking. Suspect vehicle heading towards Docklands.

check.heard: Dispatch, we have a reported carjacking. Suspect vehicle heading towards Docklands.

lines.text: Taskforce Kestrel to all units, be on the lookout. Suspect is armed.

check.heard: Tusk Force Kestrel to all units, be on the lookout, suspect is armed.

lines.text: Flinders Street's that way, mate. Under the clocks.

check.heard: Flinders Street's that way, mate. Under the clocks.

lines.text: You going to the footy Saturday? Carn the Pies!
Bloody trams. The eighty six never comes when you want it.
Lygon Street for a parma, that's my tip.
Can't stop, I'm late for work. Again.
Watch yourself round here. The Broadmeadows lot have been about.
Did you see the game on the weekend? Absolute shocker.
Yeah, nah. I reckon we'll still make the finals.
Grab a coffee on Degraves. Best in town, I reckon.
Four seasons in one day, this city. Brought the wrong jacket again.
Have you been to the Queen Vic Market? The doughnut van, mate.
Don't touch me, ya weirdo.
No worries. Have a good one.
You lost? Swanston's the one with all the trams.
Is it me, or are there more cranes than people in this town?
Honestly, the rent in Fitzroy is getting ridiculous.
